system.name: PSR J1141-6545
system.source_label: Bhat, Bailes, Verbiest (2008) with xdot caveat from Venkatraman Krishnan et al. (2020)

branches.label: scintillation_geometry
branches.note: Independent scintillation-based inclination prior used for non-gamma mass inference.

nuisance_notes: Profile-precession arguments limit aberration to < 21% of xdot_obs at 99% confidence, so >79% is attributed to WD-driven spin-orbit coupling.
The same paper quotes P_WD < 900 s at 99% confidence, or < 200 s with the prograde-rotation prior.

system.name: PSR J1906+0746

branches.label: external_i
branches.note: External inclination from Desvignes et al. (2019) as quoted in the 2026 timing paper.

branches.label: xdot_conditioned_i
branches.note: DDGR+xdot branch from the 2026 timing paper; kept as an explicit correlated nuisance branch.

nuisance_notes: The same paper states that fitting xdot shifts the individual masses by ~3.5 sigma because xdot and gamma are correlated.
In the xdot-conditioned branch the pulsar mass moves to ~1.42 Msun, pushing the source from the low-side toward the positive-s side.
